_comment: Datadog metric -> New Relic event/attribute. ALL ENTRIES ARE UNVERIFIED against a live New Relic account: confirm each in a test account before relying on it. 'scale' converts Datadog units to New Relic units. 'select' is a trusted NRQL expression used instead of an attribute. A 'note' marks the mapping as approximate.

system.mem.pct_usable.note: pct_usable includes reclaimable cache; memoryFreePercent may differ

system.swap.free.note: unit of swapFree (bytes vs megabytes) must be confirmed before enabling

trace.http.request.hits.note: APM hit counts are approximated by Transaction events

trace.http.request.errors.note: APM error counts are approximated by errored Transaction events
